channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: On a train in New York City, a woman becomes upset after hearing a group of tourists speak in their native language; in Key West, Florida, police intervene at a local bar where two men get into a confrontation with another customer; at a convenience store in Australia, a customer and employee have a heated exchange over an attempted frozen drink purchase; on a runway at a Toronto airport, a passenger records as a routine landing takes a terrifying turn.
